LESSON: KENYAN FOLK DANCE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.10: Kenyan Folk Dance

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Kenyan Folk Dance. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do folk dances represent Kenyan culture?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. classify folk dances from Kenyan communities
2. perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community
3. appreciate different cultures through performing folk dances from diverse Kenyan communities

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: KENYAN FOLK DANCE
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Kenyan Folk Dance helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: KENYAN FOLK DANCE
Study Kenyan Folk Dance like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Classify folk dances from Kenyan communities

What this means
In this part you learn to classify folk dances from Kenyan communities. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: classify folk dances from Kenyan communities.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Kenyan Folk Dance” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can classify folk dances from Kenyan communities. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community

What this means
In this part you learn to perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Kenyan Folk Dance in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate different cultures through performing folk dances from diverse Kenyan communities

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate different cultures through performing folk dances from diverse Kenyan communities. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate different cultures through performing folk dances from diverse Kenyan communities.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate different cultures through performing folk dances from diverse Kenyan communities. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Kenyan Folk Dance is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Kenyan Folk Dance” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: classify folk dances from Kenyan communities)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Kenyan Folk Dance in your own words. (skill: perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate different cultures through performing folk dances from diverse Kenyan communities)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Kenyan Folk Dance to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: classify folk dances from Kenyan communities.
3. Practise this skill: perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate different cultures through performing folk dances from diverse Kenyan communities.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Kenyan Folk Dance from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Kenyan Folk Dance: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Kenyan Folk Dance?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do folk dances represent Kenyan culture?
2. What makes a good folk dance performance?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Kenyan Folk Dance means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: classify folk dances from Kenyan communities.
5. Be able to: perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
